label: miso7 zonalload
definition: (PROBE) miso3 reserve-coopt config re-solved on current main with all merged MISO structural work — per-zone hourly load shapes from EIA-930 sub-BA demand (zones = whole sub-BA/LRZ unions, shares 0.285/0.444/0.271, WI->Central/MO->North), RDT asymmetric links (3000 N->S / 2500 S->N), per-zone wind CF shapes, #812 coal take-or-pay, firm-hydro import. Load-weighted LMP 28.98/25.89/37.11 vs actual 31.79/30.80/42.85 (-8.8/-15.9/-13.4%) — a few tenths closer than static-share miso3 but the gap persists. Scarcity tail still absent (0h >$200 vs 30/37/88) and zones don't separate (N=C, N<->C link still the 12 GW placeholder). Next levers: a binding N<->C corridor limit and a live scarcity tail, not load-share tuning.
